item.title: Microcontroller vs Microprocessors - the two totally distinct worlds
item.description:
The two totally distinct worlds - Microcontrollers vs. Microprocessors (MCU vs. CPU)

In this post we want to deepen the insight into the fundamental differences between embedded systems based on microcontrollers and desktop or server machines built around powerful CPUs with a complete operating system stack.

We will contrast an MCU platform, for example an STM32-based system, with a typical desktop CPU platform such as an AMD Ryzen system. Although both execute software and process data, they are optimized for completely different goals and usage scenarios.

While the main property of embedded systems is predictability and deterministic timing behavior, the main property of desktop and server systems driven by CPUs is high performance and overall throughput.
